Purpose.title: The Larger Purpose Behind the Synax Ecosystem
Purpose.lead: Traditional ERPs were built for finance departments, forcing shop floor engineers, quality leads, and workforce managers to survive on scattered spreadsheets. Synax exists to unify high-precision execution, human capital, and regulatory compliance into one connected system.

industry.title: Industry-Focused Solutions
industry.subtitle: Domain-native workflows instead of generic ERP workarounds
industry.body: We reject one-size-fits-all software. Synax is built around how a machine shop actually works: customer-supplied material tracked by challan and Material ID, route cards confirmed from the machine, AS9100D QMS controls at the quality checkpoints, and First Article Inspection records in the same flow.

operations.title: Smarter Business Operations
operations.subtitle: Single source of truth from material receipt to customer dispatch
operations.body: Synax connects the front office and the shop floor. Real machine counts, material lots and stage-by-stage records feed one view, so leadership sees OEE per job and the state of the floor without waiting for end-of-month reconciliation.

workforce.title: Better Workforce Management
workforce.subtitle: Unifying permanent floor staff with contingent technical talent
workforce.body: High-precision delivery needs the right people on every shift. Synax brings biometric punch-ins, plant floor break-pass management and payroll with approvals into one workspace, and its staffing tools show who is available and where each person is deployed.

technology.title: Technology-Driven Transformation
technology.subtitle: Cloud-native scale, machine connectivity & audit-ready security
technology.body: Replacing clunky legacy on-premise architectures with modern, cloud-native engineering. Synax connects CNC machines through the OEM connection or open FOCAS, runs every company in its own isolated workspace, checks postings on the server, and keeps an audit history of material changes.

banner.title: One Unified Continuum. Zero Disconnected Tools.
banner.lead: Every tier of Synax works in synchrony: from hiring and biometric clock-in to machining and AS9100D-controlled release.

Rollout.title: A phased path from discovery to optimization
Rollout.lead: Every rollout follows the same four phases. How long each one takes depends on your organization, so the schedule is planned with you.

p1.title: Discovery & Planning
p1.copy: Review departments, processes, current systems, data, and integrations, then agree the scope and a rollout plan for your organization.

p2.title: Configuration & Data Setup
p2.copy: Configure modules, roles, and approvals, then clean, import, and check employee, customer, vendor, project, and inventory records.

p3.title: Pilot Launch
p3.copy: Go live with one team, department, or site first, train its users, and resolve issues before the wider rollout.

p4.title: Full Rollout & Optimization
p4.copy: Extend to more teams, modules, and locations in planned waves, track adoption, and refine workflows once stable.

Rollout.note: Implementation timelines are tailored to your organization's size, operational complexity, and requirements. A detailed rollout plan will be established during the discovery phase.

checklist.c1: Name a rollout owner, a leadership sponsor, and department champions
checklist.c2: Prepare and check employee, customer, vendor, and project master data
checklist.c3: Document current approval, attendance, and task-update procedures

checklist.c5: Plan user training and a support period after each go-live

aerospace.title: Aerospace & Defence
aerospace.description: Built for aerospace and defence suppliers who machine customer-supplied material.
aerospace.challenge: Audit evidence assembled by hand after the part has shipped, first-article reports and certificates kept in separate files, and customer-owned material that is hard to trace to a delivered part.
aerospace.solution: AS9100D QMS controls attached at critical workflow checkpoints, a FAIR register and certificate of conformance in the same flow, material genealogy from entry to dispatch, and role-based access to drawings and records.
aerospace.c2: Certificate of Conformance with the Machining Record

energy.title: Oil, Gas & Energy
energy.description: For suppliers of machined and moulded parts to oil, gas, power and energy customers, where every part has to trace back to its material and its inspection.
energy.challenge: Material lots, inspection results and certificates are kept apart from the job, so proving where a delivered part came from means searching files after it has shipped.
energy.solution: Customer material tracked by challan and Material ID, receiving and final inspection with stage buy-offs, NCR and CAPA when a check fails, and a certificate of conformance issued from the same record.
energy.c1: Material Genealogy from Receipt to Dispatch
energy.c4: Certificate of Conformance with the Record

machinery.title: Industrial Machinery & Equipment
machinery.description: For makers of pumps, valves, compressors, gearboxes and other equipment, and for the suppliers who machine their parts.
machinery.challenge: Bills of material, routings and machine load are planned in spreadsheets, production status reaches the office late, and stores, production and dispatch are re-keyed into the books.
machinery.solution: Part masters and BOMs, operation routings and route cards released against them, machine scheduling with live counts and downtime, then packing, the GST invoice and the Tally bridge in one flow.

services.title: IT Services & Consulting
services.description: For IT services firms and technical consultancies that deliver projects and place people with clients.
services.challenge: Hours, work logs and costs are not tied to the project they belong to, unbillable bench time shows up only at month end, and client communication happens outside the system of record.
services.solution: The Work Tracker and projects, timesheets and work logs against each project, project billing with a view of profitability, and client requirements and deployments in the same workspace.

precision.title: Precision CNC Machining & Job Work
precision.description: Track customer-supplied material by challan, PO line, and material ID, then carry each job through route-card operations, machine-confirmed quantities, inspection, and dispatch.
precision.challenge: Customer-owned material, production status, inspection records, and dispatch paperwork often sit in separate sheets, making consumption and invoiced quantities difficult to reconcile.
precision.solution: Link customer POs and material challans to route cards, machine-reported counts with operator-approved variances, stage buy-offs, COC records, and GST dispatch, with vouchers bridged to Tally.
precision.c1: Customer Challans, PO Lines & Material IDs
precision.c2: Machine Counts, Alarms & Operator Variance Sign-Off
precision.c3: Route Cards, Stage Buy-Offs & COC Records
precision.c4: GST Dispatch Documents & Tally Voucher Bridge

rubber.title: Rubber & Polymer Moulding
rubber.description: For moulders of seals, gaskets, hoses and other rubber and polymer parts who work to customer POs and, often, customer-supplied material.
rubber.challenge: Customer POs, material received on challan, production lots, rejections and dispatch are kept in separate registers, so material balances and job-work returns are rebuilt by hand each period.
rubber.solution: The same Manufacturing ERP flow: customer POs and challans, a route card for each job, receiving and final inspection, rejections recorded against the job, and ITC-04 job-work records with GST dispatch.

workforce.title: Plant Workforce & HR
workforce.description: Designed for high-intensity industrial plants, multi-facility manufacturing enterprises, and shift-based engineering teams.
workforce.challenge: Buddy punching, unaccounted plant floor break passes leaving active machining lines unattended, and multi-day manual payroll calculations with complex shift differential and tax errors.
workforce.solution: Attendance, leave and work-from-home with overtime approvals, biometric device sync, payroll with approvals, and department KPIs, in the same workspace as operations.

staffing.title: Staffing & Contract Talent
staffing.description: Built for staffing agencies, technical consulting networks, and contingent workforce providers managing customer requirements and deployments.
staffing.challenge: Weeks-long recruiting cycles, consultants sitting idle on unbillable bench time, multi-vendor communication friction, and disputed timesheets and invoices.
staffing.solution: Customer requirements, candidates, interviews, offers and onboarding in one flow, with deployments, replacements and approvals tracked against each requirement.

release.title: Release

who-is-synax-built-for.a: Precision and job-work manufacturers, especially aerospace, defence and automotive suppliers who machine customer-supplied material. The same workspace also runs HR, attendance, payroll and projects.

do-we-have-to-move-our-accounts-out-of-t.q: Do we have to move our accounts out of Tally?
do-we-have-to-move-our-accounts-out-of-t.a: No. Run operations in Synax and keep your books in Tally. The Tally bridge sends the vouchers across.

which-machines-can-synax-connect-to.q: Which machines can Synax connect to?
which-machines-can-synax-connect-to.a: CNC machines through the OEM connection or open FOCAS. Machines that cannot connect still work: operators confirm counts on the shop-floor screen.

does-synax-generate-e-invoices-and-e-way.q: Does Synax generate e-invoices and e-way bills?
does-synax-generate-e-invoices-and-e-way.a: Yes. Connect your GST suvidha provider (ClearTax or Masters India) and the IRN is generated when an invoice is approved.

can-the-ai-change-our-data-on-its-own.q: Can the AI change our data on its own?
can-the-ai-change-our-data-on-its-own.a: No. Synax agents only propose. Every action waits for an approver with the right role, and the decision is recorded.

is-synax-free-for-small-manufacturers.q: Is Synax free for small manufacturers?
is-synax-free-for-small-manufacturers.a: Yes. Synax is free for SMEs with fewer than 50 employees, to support small-scale industries and Atmanirbhar Bharat.

how-long-does-onboarding-take.a: It depends on your organization's size, the modules you start with, and how ready your masters and opening stock are. Plants go live module by module, on a rollout plan agreed with you during discovery. We import part, BOM and stock data from Excel.

shopfloor.subtitle: The machine reports the count
shopfloor.lead: Connect your machines and let real cycle counts, alarms and downtime drive production confirmation, with no separate MES or integrator. Schedule work onto machines, give operators the job in front of them, and see what every machine is doing.
shopfloor.imgAlt: A blue industrial robot arm working on a production line

layers.title: Plan, run, watch
layers.lead: The same job moves from the plan, to the operator, to the machine's own record.

l1.title: Plan
l1.copy: Load the machines and release each job against the BOM. Start a job by typing the route card number or scanning its barcode, so the right job reaches the right machine.
l1.m3: Route card released against the BOM
l1.m4: Start by route card number or barcode scan

l2.title: Run
l2.copy: Give the operator the job in front of them and capture what actually happened. Cycle counts are proposed, and the operator confirms them with a variance reason.

l3.title: Watch
l3.copy: See what every machine is doing and what it has been doing. Alarms and downtime reasons are on the board, and the machining record follows the part to the certificate.

ai.title: Synax AI finds the exception and proposes the fix.
ai.subtitle: You approve.
ai.lead: Ask Synax anything about your ERP data, and let its agents watch for the problems that cost you money. Nothing changes until an approver says yes. Dashboards and reports across your workflows keep decisions on current data.
ai.gateAria: How a Synax AI action works
ai.gateNote: Every decision is kept in the event history. Agents cannot change your data on their own.

approval.title: The AI proposes. A person decides.
approval.lead: Agents cannot change your data on their own. Every action waits for an approver with the right role, and the decision is recorded.

l1.title: The agent finds the exception
l1.copy: Agents watch your records for the problems that cost money: an overdue return, a lot that is not ready, a payment that is late.

l2.title: The agent proposes the fix
l2.copy: Instead of changing anything, it drafts the action: a reminder, a follow-up, a note for the right person.

l3.title: An approver decides
l3.copy: Every action waits for an approver with the right role. This is the maker-checker model the rest of Synax already uses.

l4.title: The decision is recorded
l4.copy: Who approved what, and when, is kept in a full event history, next to the record it changed.

Chat.greet2: I can answer common questions about our products, or pass you to the team. What would you like to know?

reply.demo: Happy to set that up. It is a short walkthrough with a Senwell Group systems engineer, using your own parts, people and processes.
reply.products: Synax has six products in one workspace. Manufacturing ERP covers customer orders to the GST invoice, Shop Floor & Machine Monitoring covers live machines, HRMS covers attendance and payroll, and there are products for work and delivery, staffing, and AI. Tell me what you do and I will point you to the right one.
reply.pricing: Synax is free for small manufacturers (SMEs under 50 employees). For larger teams the plan depends on the modules and users, so the team will share the details with you.
reply.tally: No need to move your accounts. Run operations in Synax and keep your books in Tally: the Tally bridge sends the vouchers across.
reply.gst: GST invoices, the IRN and e-way bills come from the same flow as production and dispatch, using your GST suvidha provider.
reply.machines: CNC machines can connect through the manufacturer's own connection or open FOCAS. Machines that cannot connect still work: operators confirm the counts on the shop-floor screen.
reply.hr: HRMS covers employee records, attendance, leave and work from home, and payroll with approvals. Attendance logs and overtime approvals sync from biometric devices.
reply.security: Every company runs in its own tenant, stock and status changes are checked on the server, and an audit history is kept. The details are on the Security & Trust page.
reply.person: Don't have time to wait for a response? Leave your email address and we'll be in touch as soon as possible.
reply.fallback: Thanks for your message. I am an automated assistant, so I will pass this on to the team. Leave your email address and someone will reply.
